_comment: Synthetic G36 VAV fleet (generator g36_vav_fleet, camber/datasets/_synthetic_g36_vav_fleet.py; 0.105, #144) -> CAMBER Role mapping for one single-duct reheat box; the run's vars fill {n} (1 to 6). Every column is CAMBER's own: ZN{n}_T the space temperature, ZN{n}_CLG_SP and ZN{n}_HTG_SP its active cooling and heating setpoints in F (set back to 80 and 62 with the fan off), ZN{n}_FLOW the box's airflow in cfm, ZN{n}_FLOW_SP its active airflow setpoint in cfm (what the controller asks for this hour, between the minimum and the cooling or heating maximum; 0 with the fan off; the static-pressure census and cohort_airflow compare the airflow with it), ZN{n}_FLOW_MIN its minimum airflow setpoint in cfm (airflow_min_sp: the reheat-at-minimum rules read it), ZN{n}_DMPR the damper position in %, ZN{n}_RHT_VLV the reheat valve command in %, ZN{n}_HTG_LOOP and ZN{n}_CLG_LOOP the zone's heating and cooling loop outputs in % (0 with the fan off; generator version 2, 0.106). The air handler's SF_STS and OCC are mapped onto every box too, so the reset-request censuses count only cycles with the fan on and the building occupied. The scenario column selects one air handler per ingest run and is not a point.
